tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The single indigo accent and the only interactive colour: filled buttons, links, focus rings, selected tabs and sidebar rows, toggles, slider fills. 5.65:1 on color-bg, 4.98:1 on color-bg-tertiary. Dark: lightened so it reads as text on dark grounds (5.65:1 on color-bg); fills carry text-on-accent (dark ink, 6.12:1).

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of color-accent controls. White text on it is 7.54:1.

tokens.name: color-accent-light
tokens.usage: 8% accent tint: tinted buttons, selected sidebar rows, symbol tiles, badges, the text-field focus halo. Never carries text contrast on its own; text on it is color-accent or color-text-primary.

tokens.name: color-accent-glow
tokens.usage: 15% accent, used only as the 1px ring (ring-accent) paired with shadow-md on hovered cards. Also the hover fill of tinted buttons.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Indigo-tinted ink for titles and body copy on color-bg, color-bg-secondary and color-bg-tertiary (17.1 / 16.1 / 15.1:1). Never pure black. Dark: 14.5:1 on color-bg, 10.4:1 on color-bg-tertiary.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, list detail text, unselected tab-bar labels, body prose in cards. 5.61:1 on color-bg, 4.95:1 on color-bg-tertiary. Dark: 7.2:1 on color-bg, 5.2:1 on color-bg-tertiary.

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, meta lines, disabled labels, inactive page-control dots. 3.18:1 on color-bg: below 4.5:1, so never for prose or labels under 24px (kept exact from the Arlo source). Dark: 4.1:1 on color-bg; same faint-only role as in light.

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: The page, cards, lists, alerts, sheets, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: color-bg-secondary
tokens.usage: Alternating page sections, sidebars, grouped-list backgrounds, table headers.

tokens.name: color-bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Inert tracks and gray fills: segmented-control track, toggle off, slider rail, gray buttons, search field.

tokens.name: color-bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised overlays: menus, popovers, alerts, sheets. White in light (same as color-bg); lighter than the page in dark, where elevation reads as lightness. color-text-primary is 12.8:1 on it in dark.

tokens.name: color-segment
tokens.usage: The selected segment of a segmented control, lifted above the color-bg-tertiary track. color-text-primary on it: 17.1:1 light, 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Hairline: card and list borders, list separators, nav and tab-bar edges. Black-alpha so it sits on white and tinted grounds alike.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines: text fields, outline buttons, checkbox and radio borders at rest.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success state only: symbols, progress complete, short status words. Apple system green (iOS accessible light variant / standard dark). 4.40:1 on color-bg in light: just under 4.5:1, so small success words stay in color-text-primary beside a green symbol; 18px semibold and larger may be green. Dark: 8.41:1 on color-bg.

tokens.name: color-success-light
tokens.usage: Success badge and banner fill.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state only: symbols, delays, limits. Apple system orange (accessible light variant / standard dark). 5.28:1 on color-bg in light, 8.27:1 in dark, so it works as small text. Close in hue to color-danger in light: always pair it with exclamationmark.triangle, never colour alone.

tokens.name: color-warning-light
tokens.usage: Warning badge and banner fill.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons and menu items, error text, count badges. Apple system red (accessible light variant / standard dark). 5.38:1 on color-bg and white on it 5.38:1 in light; dark 4.99:1 on color-bg, fills carry text-on-accent (dark ink, 5.40:1). Pair errors with exclamationmark.circle or xmark.circle.fill, not the warning triangle.

tokens.name: color-danger-light
tokens.usage: Error badge, banner and invalid-field fill.

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind alerts and sheets.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on color-accent, color-accent-hover and color-danger fills: white in light, dark ink in dark. Dark: dark ink on the lightened accent and danger fills (M3's on-primary approach).

tokens.name: color-bar
tokens.usage: Translucent fill of navigation bars, tab bars and the site nav, always with saturate(180%) blur(20px).

tokens.name: color-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of gray buttons and other color-bg-tertiary controls.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Semantic alias: cards, list groups, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Semantic alias: tracks and gray control fills.

tokens.usage: Semantic alias: body copy.

tokens.usage: Semantic alias: secondary copy.

spacing.note: Material 3 spacing: an 8dp scale where space100 = 8px, named by multiplier (space250 would be 2.5x). Nested units cover 2, 4, 6 and 10.

tokens.name: space0
tokens.usage: No space: flush edges, joined segments.

tokens.name: space25
tokens.usage: Nested unit 0.25x: segmented-control track inset, badge-to-symbol nudges.

tokens.name: space50
tokens.usage: Nested unit 0.5x: symbol-to-label gap in compact controls, list subtitle gap.

tokens.name: space75
tokens.usage: Nested unit 0.75x: symbol-to-label gap in buttons, small badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space100
tokens.usage: Base unit 1x: gap between grouped controls, search-field padding, menu inset.

tokens.name: space125
tokens.usage: Nested unit 1.25x: menu-item and badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space200
tokens.usage: 2x: button and list-row horizontal padding, compact window margin, card gap on compact.

tokens.name: space300
tokens.usage: 3x: card padding, alert padding, medium/expanded window margin, pane spacer, card-grid gap.

tokens.name: space400
tokens.usage: 4x: card vertical padding on large cards, gap between page sections inside a pane.

tokens.name: space500
tokens.usage: 5x: large empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space600
tokens.usage: 6x: space between a page title and its first group.

tokens.name: space800
tokens.usage: 8x: section header to content (Arlo 64px).

tokens.name: space900
tokens.usage: 9x: the top of the scale.

tokens.name: margin-compact
tokens.usage: Window margin below 600px wide (M3 compact).

tokens.name: margin-medium
tokens.usage: Window margin 600px and up (M3 medium, expanded, large).

tokens.name: pane-spacer
tokens.usage: Gap between panes, such as sidebar and content (M3 spacer).

tokens.name: section-padding
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of marketing page sections: Arlo's 100px snapped to the 8dp scale (12x).

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width of marketing pages, centred (Arlo container).

radius.note: Arlo's radius scale, unchanged, plus radius-button: one fixed 12px corner for buttons, segmented controls and steppers, instead of Material's full pill or Apple's height-based capsule.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bars: navigation bar, tab bar, toolbars.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: 16-20px controls: checkbox boxes.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The rounded square inside every Arlo brand mark; symbol tiles at 28px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields, search fields, pop-up menus' items area, sidebar rows, 36-44px symbol tiles.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Every button, segmented control, stepper and pop-up button, at all sizes (28, 36 and 44px). A fixed 12px corner, not Material's full pill or Apple's capsule: at 28px it is nearly round, at 44px it stays a soft rectangle.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, inset list groups, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, alerts, sheets (top corners), dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles, badges, tags, progress and slider tracks, page-control dots: shapes that are capsules by nature, not buttons.

shadow.note: Arlo's soft black-alpha shadows. Depth comes from hairlines and tonal layers first.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Toggle knobs, slider thumbs, the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards (with ring-accent), popovers on light grounds.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Alerts and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered filled (accent) button only.

tokens.name: ring-accent
tokens.usage: 1px glow ring paired with shadow-md on hovered, interactive cards.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on every control: a 2px white gap then a solid 2px accent ring (5.65:1 on color-bg). Added: the source's 8% halo is too faint to meet 3:1.

tokens.name: halo-focus
tokens.usage: Arlo's soft halo around a focused text field, always together with a color-accent border.

size.note: Control and symbol sizes. Hit targets follow Apple (44pt minimum on touch).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small control height for pointer UI: small buttons, segmented controls, steppers, compact menu items (ar-menu--compact). Never a touch size: these grow to control-md on touch devices and keep a 44px hit area.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height: buttons, text fields, search fields, pop-up buttons.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large control height and the minimum hit area for anything tappable (Apple's 44pt): menu items, sidebar rows, list rows, tab-bar items, navigation actions; buttons and fields grow to it on touch devices.

tokens.name: symbol-sm
tokens.usage: SF Symbol beside label-large/body-medium text and in small buttons.

tokens.name: symbol-md
tokens.usage: SF Symbol in default buttons, sidebars, toolbars and list rows.

tokens.name: symbol-lg
tokens.usage: SF Symbol in tab bars, navigation bars and 44px buttons.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Arlo marketing nav bar height (app navigation bars are control-lg, 44px).
